content.value_statement: Organizations need clear GDPR and DSGVO guidance for complex privacy obligations. This skill structures audits, DPIAs, rights handling, transfer reviews, and DPO support.
actual_capabilities: Maps GDPR and DSGVO compliance program areas across lawful basis, rights, accountability, and transfers.
Structures Data Protection Impact Assessment planning, execution, documentation, and review steps.
Guides data subject rights workflows, including verification, response timelines, fulfillment, and documentation.
Covers German privacy considerations, including BDSG coordination and sector-specific requirements.
Supports privacy audit planning, evidence review, finding reporting, and remediation planning.
Provides DPO support topics for governance, advisory work, training, and independence checks.
limitations: It does not provide binding legal advice or replace qualified privacy counsel.
It does not verify live systems, contracts, records, or regulator guidance by itself.
It names example resources that are not fully implemented in this package.
It may need updated legal review for new court decisions or supervisory authority guidance.

use_cases.title: Prepare an Internal Privacy Audit
use_cases.description: Build an audit scope, evidence request list, control checklist, and remediation plan for GDPR compliance.

use_cases.title: Run a DPIA Readiness Review
use_cases.description: Assess whether planned processing needs a DPIA and identify privacy risks, safeguards, and documentation gaps.
use_cases.target_user: Product teams and data protection officers

use_cases.title: Improve Data Subject Rights Handling
use_cases.description: Design request intake, identity verification, response tracking, and decision documentation for rights requests.

prompt_templates.title: Basic GDPR Gap Check
prompt_templates.scenario: Beginner review of an existing privacy program.
prompt_templates.prompt: Review our GDPR program summary. Identify the main compliance gaps, missing evidence, and priority next steps.

prompt_templates.title: DPIA Threshold Assessment
prompt_templates.scenario: Intermediate assessment for a new processing activity.
prompt_templates.prompt: Assess whether this processing activity needs a DPIA. Consider scale, data categories, risks, legal basis, and safeguards.

prompt_templates.title: Rights Request Workflow Design
prompt_templates.prompt: Create a data subject rights workflow for our organization. Include intake, identity checks, deadlines, decision logs, and escalation points.

prompt_templates.title: Advanced Audit Preparation
prompt_templates.scenario: Advanced preparation for supervisory authority or external audit review.
prompt_templates.prompt: Prepare a GDPR audit plan for this business unit. Define scope, evidence, interview topics, controls, risk ratings, and remediation governance.

output_examples.input: We process employee health data for absence management in Germany.
output_examples.output: The skill would outline likely special category data issues, lawful basis questions, BDSG considerations, DPIA triggers, safeguards, and documentation needs.

output_examples.input: A customer requested access and erasure for account records.
output_examples.output: The skill would provide a rights handling checklist covering identity verification, scope review, exemptions, response timing, records retrieval, and decision documentation.

output_examples.input: Our vendor transfers analytics data to a third country.
output_examples.output: The skill would structure a Chapter V transfer review with transfer mechanism checks, supplementary measures, risk assessment, and contract evidence.

best_practices: Provide the processing purpose, data categories, systems, recipients, retention period, and countries involved.
Ask for structured outputs such as risk registers, audit checklists, DPIA sections, or remediation plans.
Validate recommendations with current law, supervisory authority guidance, and qualified privacy counsel.
anti_patterns: Do not use the skill as a final legal opinion without expert review.
Do not omit key facts about data categories, transfers, vendors, or affected individuals.
Do not treat generated checklists as proof of compliance without evidence testing.

faq.question: Does this skill cover both GDPR and German DSGVO topics?
faq.answer: Yes. It covers EU GDPR topics and German implementation considerations, including BDSG coordination.

faq.question: Can it replace a Data Protection Officer or lawyer?
faq.answer: No. It supports analysis and preparation, but legal accountability remains with qualified professionals.

faq.question: Can it help with DPIAs?
faq.answer: Yes. It can structure threshold assessments, risk analysis, safeguards, consultation needs, and documentation.

faq.question: Does it execute compliance automation scripts?
faq.answer: No. The package mainly provides guidance. Listed scripts are examples and are not implemented compliance tools.

faq.question: Is it useful for healthcare or medical device data?
faq.answer: Yes. It includes healthcare and medical device privacy topics, especially special category data handling.

faq.question: How should users prepare inputs?
faq.answer: Share clear facts about processing, data types, vendors, transfers, legal basis, retention, and existing controls.
